hook.text: What if you could treat a genetic disease at birth—before damage occurs? Newborn gene therapy aims for exactly that.

buildup.text: Diseases like SMA cause irreversible harm in months. The earlier therapy starts, the better the outcome.

discovery.text: Babies given Zolgensma within two weeks of birth show near-normal development. Timing is everything.

twist.text: This requires fast newborn screening—accurate and universal. The bottleneck is diagnosis speed, not therapy.

climax.text: Pairing newborn screening with immediate gene therapy could prevent dozens of diseases. Screen, diagnose, treat—in days.

punchline.text: Screen at birth. Treat in days. Disease prevented.

quiz.question: Why is timing critical for newborn gene therapy?
options: Many genetic diseases cause irreversible damage fast
Gene therapy only works on small bodies
